text:
Stop punishing yourself for what they did to you.

It's 2 a.m. You're awake. Some part of you feels like you don't deserve better. Like you're the problem.

That feeling has a name. Call it the guilt trap. It started when someone treated you badly young. Your brain filed it wrong: their fault became your flaw.

Here's the test: were you trying to hurt anyone? No? Then the trap is fake.

Let it go. A man free of that lie attracts everything the guilty man pushes away.
caption:
Self improvement stalls when discipline can't fix the real problem: the guilt men carry from wounds they never caused.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
